title: Fall 2026 Base Camp (1st-8th grade or K) (Copy) — Wayfinders on the Hudson
top_headings: Wayfinders Fall Base Camp | Get active & energized at Fall Base Camp! | Wayfinders | Base Camp | connects us with ourselves, each other, and the earth. We create community through weekly fire circles, where we share gratitude and sing! We play immersive nature connection games that teach about the ecosystem through the invisible teachers - nature, fun and play! There is a ton of social emotional learning through our commitment to building a community of inclusion and kindness. Seasoned Wayfinders hone their leadership development through leading new friends in activities. Our community is strong and keeps growing stronger! | “Restoration Nation”: This season we will explore our local ecosystem through planting native trees, shrubs, grasses, and forbs in our ecosystem restoration project at Lenoir Preserve. | Same age and mixed age opportunities are available throughout Base Camp. Mixed age groups foster personal growth and village building. Younger kids look up to older kids as role models. Older kids grow into strong leaders as they facilitate activities and work with younger kids. | Base Camp meets after school on Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons for 1st-8th graders (some participants join us for both days), and on Thursdays for Kindergarteners!
